panels.description: Cost Management ActualCost for the current UTC day. Billing data normally trails token telemetry by several hours.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
FoundryModelCost_CL
| top 1 by TimeGenerated desc
| mv-expand row = CostQueryRows
| extend Cost = todouble(row[0]), UsageDateText = tostring(toint(row[2]))
| extend UsageDate = todatetime(strcat(substring(UsageDateText, 0, 4), '-', substring(UsageDateText, 4, 2), '-', substring(UsageDateText, 6, 2)))
| summarize Value = sumif(Cost, UsageDate >= startofday(now()))

panels.title: Billed tokens and actual cost by model
panels.description: Daily, rolling seven-day, and month-to-date billed usage from Cost Management. Cached-token meters are included. Azure Monitor token panels above are the near-real-time leading indicator.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
FoundryModelCost_CL
| top 1 by TimeGenerated desc
| mv-expand row = CostQueryRows
| extend Cost = todouble(row[0]), UsageQuantity = todouble(row[1]), UsageDateText = tostring(toint(row[2])), Meter = tostring(row[3])
| extend UsageDate = todatetime(strcat(substring(UsageDateText, 0, 4), '-', substring(UsageDateText, 4, 2), '-', substring(UsageDateText, 6, 2)))
| extend Model = case(Meter startswith '5.6 sol ', 'gpt-5-6-sol', Meter startswith '5.6 terra ', 'gpt-5-6-terra', Meter startswith '5.6 luna ', 'gpt-5-6-luna', Meter startswith 'V4 Pro ', 'deepseek-v4-pro', Meter startswith 'V4 Flash ', 'deepseek-v4-flash', Meter startswith 'Grok 4.2 ', 'grok-4-20-reasoning', Meter startswith '4.3 ', 'grok-4-3', Meter startswith 'Grok 4.1 ', 'grok-4-1-fast-reasoning', Meter startswith 'Large 3 ', 'mistral-large-3', Meter startswith 'Llama 4 Maverick 17B ', 'llama-4-maverick-17b', Meter startswith 'K2.7 Code ', 'kimi-k2-7-code', Meter startswith 'Phi-4-reasoning-', 'phi-4-reasoning', Meter startswith 'text-embedding-3-large', 'text-embedding-3-large', Meter startswith 'text-embedding-3-small', 'text-embedding-3-small', Meter)
| extend Tokens = tolong(round(UsageQuantity * iff(Meter contains '1M Tokens', 1000000.0, 1000.0)))
| summarize TodayTokens = sumif(Tokens, UsageDate >= startofday(now())), TodayCost = sumif(Cost, UsageDate >= startofday(now())), SevenDayTokens = sumif(Tokens, UsageDate >= startofday(now() - 6d)), SevenDayCost = sumif(Cost, UsageDate >= startofday(now() - 6d)), MonthTokens = sum(Tokens), MonthCost = sum(Cost) by Model
| order by MonthCost desc

Gateway requests and errors
panels.description: Traffic through the gateway. A rising 4xx line is usually a caller presenting the wrong gateway token, not a model problem.

targets.alias: HTTP 4xx (includes 401 from callers with no token)

panels.title: Gateway response time
panels.description: Includes the model call itself, so this tracks model latency plus the gateway hop. A step change with flat model latency means the gateway, not the model.

panels.title: Gateway health check
panels.description: The platform probing /health. Below 100 means instances are failing the probe. This is the panel that tells you the gateway is down before a person does.

panels.title: Gateway CPU and memory
panels.description: B1 is a small tier. If either of these saturates while requests are flat, the shim is not the bottleneck and the tier needs raising.
